title: Teamwork Is a Force Multiplier
verse: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good! You will surely wear out, both you and these people who are with you, for this is too heavy a burden for you; you are not able to do it by yourself.
observation: Today’s passage is part of a popular chapter in leadership and management circles. Jethro’s advice to Moses is a powerful example of how organizational leadership is supposed to work. Everyone is part of something bigger than themselves. They have authority and are under authority. This creates a system of checks and balances. However, what is often missed is the miracle of limitations. If Moses had not been limited in his ability to help everyone, there would have never been the opportunity for all these other leaders to serve. Many times we see our limitations as a liability, but it is not always so simple. Sometimes, God allows us to be limited to provide opportunities for us to be part of a team. We cannot do it all by ourselves. We are not supposed to be. We were made for community. When we work together, we are able to do more than we could ever do alone.
application: How can you help someone else fulfill what God is calling them to do? Who do you need to bring alongside you?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us all gifts, talents, abilities and opportunities to make a difference.
